identity: One bounded Invoke Define then Design artifact author and local validator
angle: Improve the existing formal-claims/specification ontology branch by separating expressive FOL meaning from executable and provider-specific projections.
instructions: Read the named Invoke, Context Builder, Inventory, Interrogation, Distill, and Dispatch Spec contracts before acting.
Build a strict standard-mode runtime context pack with no more than 14 exact source files and selector-level obligation mappings.
Use the current Inventory index in lookup-only mode and preserve its authority ceiling.
Treat the user request and already selected one-semantic-graph architecture as approved Define intent, not protected owner admission.
Author a successor candidate; never edit, replace, or claim to supersede frozen @4.

Define full FOL as source-level FormalClaim expressiveness with explicit typed AST identity, theory requirements, quantifier/domain policy, source meaning binding, profile classification, claim ceiling, currentness, and supersession.
Keep TDE limited to the explicit decidable executable projection; retain needs_formal when no sound projection exists.
Keep EVF limited to optional verification/witness evidence routing and keep SMT-provider runtime execution separately owned and pinned.
Make unsupported, unknown, timeout, incomplete, stale, or wider-than-source results fail closed and never count as pass, proof, discharge, or meaning.

Include all six required Design views, exact interface contracts, glossary consistency, decisions/risks, layering seed, planned witnesses marked unimplemented/unexecuted, a closed scope manifest, extracted denominator, total two-pass fixed-point selection, and a compact Distill design-unit check.

Do not create Work Packs, SWUs, implementation tasks, migration postimages, owner responses, verifier receipts, canonical ontology mutations, runtime executions, promotion, publication, Git, or telemetry changes.

read_policy.fallback: Search only within the listed source directories for an uncovered declared obligation; record every extra source and why it was necessary.

forbidden: all frozen @4 and prior candidate paths
all product, Craft, Arcanum, authority, telemetry, Git, owner-response, verifier, migration, execution, promotion, publication, release, deployment, and external paths

done_criteria: Define outputs satisfy discovery, context, gap-check, template selection, glossary, layering, technique trace, Distill sanity, transport, and next-route contracts.
Design outputs contain six views and all required companion artifacts.
DesignScopeManifest is schema-valid, selector-closed, digest-current, independently detected, and has no unknowns.
The installed extractor emits a passing denominator and the installed selection validator emits identical pass-one and pass-two results.
Every planned witness is explicitly unimplemented and unexecuted.
All JSON parses; all Markdown is free of trailing whitespace; all written paths are regular non-symlink files inside the allowlist.
Frozen @4 and every listed source hash are unchanged.
HELPER-RECEIPT.json records exact changed bytes, checks, blockers, claim ceiling, authority_effect none, and ready-for-parent-rejoin.
authority_ceiling: Private run-local Invoke Define and Design candidate evidence only. No owner acceptance, verifier admission, canonical ontology change, implementation readiness, execution authority, proof, discharge, promotion, publication, release, deployment, or production claim.
